test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The average weight of 40 boys is 52 kg. If the weight of the teacher is added, the new average becomes 52.5 kg. What is the teacher's weight?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Teacher weight = New Average + (Increase in Average × Previous Number of Boys)

Increase in Average = 52.5 − 52 = 0.5 kg

Teacher weight = 52.5 + (0.5 × 40)

Teacher weight = 52.5 + 20 = 72.5 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 72.5 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of boys = 40

Initial average weight = 52 kg

New average weight (including teacher) = 52.5 kg

**Formula Used:**

Total Weight = Average × Number of People

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6d3cbeef241912c1593ccb7be83eb2e28524f5f4b92ae175257ad64c9ec6429.png] 

⇒ Total weight of 40 boys = 40 × 52 = 2080 kg

⇒ Total number of people = 40 + 1 = 41

⇒ Total weight of 41 people = 41 × 52.5 = 2152.5 kg

⇒ Teacher weight = Total weight of 41 people − Total weight of 40 boys

⇒ Teacher weight = 2152.5 − 2080 = 72.5 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 72.5 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

The average is the sum of all values divided by the total count: Average = Σx ÷ n.

Net Deviation Method

In any group, the sum of deviations from the average is always zero. If one person joins and increases the average, they must bring the (new average + total previous deviation).

Weighted Average

When two groups with different averages are combined, the new average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p
